cases.input: A chat turn asks an employee to investigate but carries no delegation reference.
cases.expect: Minutes may record a task proposal; no ordered WM-ACT-006 task or official decision is inferred.

cases.input: A later quorate meeting conducts an authorized vote and issues a fixed decision record.
cases.expect: The earlier record remains unchanged; WM-ACT-024 and WM-REC-010 supply decision authority and effect onset.

cases.input: One session produces concise minutes and a machine transcript.
cases.expect: Two separate works are minted with distinct fidelity claims, expressions and manifestations.

cases.input: A speaker attribution is wrong after minutes approval.
cases.expect: An erratum or successor expression corrects attribution; approved bytes and prior expression remain resolvable.

cases.input: Closed-session content is quoted into a public draft.
cases.expect: Publication is blocked unless governed declassification or redaction exists; the stricter access scope wins.

cases.input: An encrypted side channel cannot be captured and only metadata is available.
cases.expect: The transcript records the capture gap and fidelity limitation; missing content is not fabricated.

cases.input: Normal disposition date arrives while a legal hold applies.
cases.expect: Deletion is blocked; hold and schedule remain recorded and any later disposition leaves a tombstone.
